data.desc: XCF Global, Inc. ('XCF') is a U.S.-based renewable energy company focused on accelerating the production and deployment of lower-carbon fuels and environmental solutions. Following its recent combinations with DevvStream Corp. and Southern Energy Renewables, XCF is building a broader platform spanning renewable fuels, carbon management and environmental assets. The Company's flagship facility, New Rise Renewables Reno, produces renewable diesel and has a permitted nameplate production capacity of up to 38 million gallons per year. XCF is also seeking to advance a pipeline of potential expansion opportunities in Nevada, North Carolina and Florida and build relationships across the energy and transportation sectors that it believes could support the scaling of renewable fuel production. Any such opportunities remain subject to, among other factors, feasibility assessments, financing, regulatory approvals and market conditions.
